Name: Hadron Engine
Effect: When this Pokémon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of the Move Electric Terrain. (In the case of a stalemate the Pokémon with higher Will might keep the dominant Terrain). While Electric Terrain is active, increase this Pokémon's Special Attribute by 2.
Description: This Pokémon's body is able to accelerate particles and transform them into energy. Theory is that it's simply bringing forward energy from another universe.
